whatThisLaneDid: Opted five Rhode Island families, which share one build host, into FIX50's suppressSynthesizedAppearances option through one finalizer option, rebuilt them and measured the delivered ink. It changed no shared machinery and no other family.

rows.buildHost: scripts/build-census-v1-ri_decriminalized-set.mjs (the shared Rhode Island host; scripts/build-census-v1-ri_decriminalized-set.mjs is the 16-line entry that calls runRhodeIslandFamily on it)
rows.sharedMachinery: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs sanitizeAndFlatten and scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs finalizeOfficialForm, both unchanged by this lane. FIX50 added the option; FIX59 only opts in.
rows.grantConfirmed: CLAIM_OK FIX59 ri_decriminalized-set (repair, grant set e65ade4647fc32cb), exit 0. Asserted before any family artifact was opened.

verdictRepaired.asVF08PutIt: 74 selection-widget readings across the two bound fixtures deliver a black-bordered square that DC-33 does not print; the zero-write baseline over the same pinned bytes paints the same pixels, so the ink comes from the shared flattening step. REPAIR: opt this family's builder into suppressSynthesizedAppearances, rebuild, re-raster centrally, re-read the obligation.

obligationsThisRowDoesNotDischarge: RASTER. A fresh central raster is owed on the new bytes. The family's standing RASTER_PASS receipt is bound to the superseded digests recorded below and stops binding. RASTER_QUEUE.json and MASTER_QUEUE.json were read and never opened for writing; the pdftoppm rasters in this row are local measurement only and were deleted.
INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. This lane opted the family in and built the bytes, so it verifies none of them. No verdict was written or replaced and acceptanceReceipt is null.
PROMOTION. No route is opened, no build status advanced, no product wiring edited.

THE FOUR CASES THE OPTION DELIBERATELY LEAVES ALONE, as FIX50 defined them: a widget shipping its own appearance for its current state, a widget with no /AS, a widget whose /AP /N is a bare stream, and any widget of a field the finalizer wrote. Measured here and unaltered, so if any of them is a defect it is an open one.
THE REST OF THE FIX50 COHORT. Only these five Rhode Island families are opted in. Rhode Island's other families and every other jurisdiction stay on the default and were not touched.

whatChanged.theOneEdit: One option, suppressSynthesizedAppearances: true, added to the single finalizeOfficialForm call in renderOfficialForm in scripts/build-census-v1-ri_decriminalized-set.mjs, with a comment naming the measurement. That host serves all five families, so one opt-in serves all five and no other builder file was edited.
whatChanged.whatWasNotEdited: No field map, no census, no fact, no write, no packet text, no page order, no component set. FIX35's changes to this host are untouched. The shared sanitizer and finalizer are untouched: the option and its default-off behaviour are FIX50's and this lane changed neither.
whatChanged.theMeasuredDefect: DC-33 ships 39 selection widgets. 37 of them sit at /AS /Off with /On as the only state in /AP /N, so pdf-lib's updateFieldAppearances() regenerates an appearance for exactly that condition and its default provider paints a stroked square that flatten() stamps onto the page. Under ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 a conforming viewer paints nothing where /AS names no stream, and the pinned form paints none of those pixels.
whatChanged.whatTheOptionDoes: It installs an EMPTY form XObject for the missing state, sized to the widget's own /Rect, so pdf-lib reports no update needed and flattens a stream that paints nothing. It supplies the state the source omitted rather than suppressing a drawing.
whatChanged.theTwoRouteMarks: This host writes nothing through the finalizer and draws its two route-determined marks afterwards through finalizeFlatOverlay, as page content. Those marks are untouched by the option and are measured below.

perWidgetMeasurement.method: Every page of both fixtures rastered with pdftoppm at 150 dpi greyscale before and after, into /tmp. Every widget /Rect was read first-hand from the pinned DC-33 by content hash (sha256 342337451d61e363e03febb384431dba2f9bb08b44ee46380b94fc91901e9908, re-verified against the bytes in this container), each rect converted to pixels and inflated by one pixel, and dark pixels (<128) counted at every rect on the delivered page, on the same rect of the pinned form's own raster, and on the delivered page after the rebuild. Every pixel of every page was compared before against after. Rasters deleted after measuring.
perWidgetMeasurement.pageAlignment: The delivered page carrying each source page was taken from the family's own pageManifest and licensed by the measurement itself: at every one of the mapped rects the delivered page and the source page agree on the form's own ink after the repair, which a mis-mapped page could not produce.

perWidgetMeasurement.theFormsOwnInkNowMatchesExactly: 35 of the 37 exposed widgets per fixture now carry EXACTLY the pinned form's own dark-pixel count at their rect, having carried more than the form before.
perWidgetMeasurement.theTwoThatDoNotMatchAreTheIntendedMarks: The two route-determined election boxes on packet page 2. Each lost exactly the same pixels as the synthesized square on every other widget of its size, and the ink that remains above the form's own box is the packet's own mark, drawn as page content after flatten by finalizeFlatOverlay and never touched by this option. Both are recorded in markedRouteBoxes above with their before, after and form-ink counts.
perWidgetMeasurement.widgetsShippingTheirOwnOffAppearance: 2 per fixture, the radio group on the last page of the form. BYTE-IDENTICAL ink before and after in both fixtures, which is what RI-OFF-APPEARANCE requires: that stream is the court's own and the option does not reach it. Confirmed by measurement, not assumed.
perWidgetMeasurement.everyParticipantWriteUnchanged: pdftotext -layout over every page of both fixtures is byte-identical before and after, and every page carrying no exposed widget is PIXEL-identical. Not one write moved, changed size or changed value.

digests.beforeDigestsConfirmedAgainstVF08: Both fixture digests were hashed in this container before any edit and equal the digests VF08 recorded in vf08/COHORT_MEASUREMENT.json and vf08/rows.json exactly. The build was not started until they did.
digests.whyTheFilesGotSMALLER: An empty appearance stream replaces a generated one carrying a rectangle path, a stroke and a graphics-state block.

rebuild.runTwice: The whole family directory was copied aside after the first build and diffed with diff -r against the second. Zero differences across every file: the rebuild is byte-identical.

The evidence is the raster.

whatChanged.theOneEdit: One option, suppressSynthesizedAppearances: true, added to the single finalizeOfficialForm call in renderOfficialForm in scripts/build-census-v1-ri_decriminalized-set.mjs, with a comment naming the measurement. whatChanged.whatWasNotEdited: No field map, no census, no fact, no write, no packet text, no page order, no component set. FIX35's changes to this host are untouched. The shared sanitizer and finalizer are untouched: the option and its default-off behaviour are FIX50's and this lane changed neither.
whatChanged.theMeasuredDefect: DC-33 ships 39 selection widgets. 37 of them sit at /AS /Off with /On as the only state in /AP /N, so pdf-lib's updateFieldAppearances() regenerates an appearance for exactly that condition and its default provider paints a stroked square that flatten() stamps onto the page. Under ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 a conforming viewer paints nothing where /AS names no stream, and the pinned form paints none of those pixels.
whatChanged.whatTheOptionDoes: It installs an EMPTY form XObject for the missing state, sized to the widget's own /Rect, so pdf-lib reports no update needed and flattens a stream that paints nothing. It supplies the state the source omitted rather than suppressing a drawing.
whatChanged.theTwoRouteMarks: This host writes nothing through the finalizer and draws its two route-determined marks afterwards through finalizeFlatOverlay, as page content. Those marks are untouched by the option and are measured below.

perWidgetMeasurement.method: Every page of both fixtures rastered with pdftoppm at 150 dpi greyscale before and after, into /tmp. Every widget /Rect was read first-hand from the pinned DC-33 by content hash (sha256 342337451d61e363e03febb384431dba2f9bb08b44ee46380b94fc91901e9908, re-verified against the bytes in this container), each rect converted to pixels and inflated by one pixel, and dark pixels (<128) counted at every rect on the delivered page, on the same rect of the pinned form's own raster, and on the delivered page after the rebuild. Every pixel of every page was compared before against after. Rasters deleted after measuring.
perWidgetMeasurement.pageAlignment: The delivered page carrying each source page was taken from the family's own pageManifest and licensed by the measurement itself: at every one of the mapped rects the delivered page and the source page agree on the form's own ink after the repair, which a mis-mapped page could not produce.
